comment: L2I-04-PLUGINS-OTHER: dialog-DEPTH contracts (dialog-action) for plugins/other/ai dialogs. Deviation note: every ledger row assigned to this task (plugins.*, other.*, review.grammar-spelling, file.mail-merge, protect.encrypt, headerfooter.*) is ALREADY bound to a green dialog-visible override from base or a sibling drop-in (plugins.json / plugins-view.json / ai-tab.json / review.json / insert-struct.json etc.) via token-precedence (overrides[token] || overrides[feature]) — any feature/token key here would either be shadowed (dead) or REPLACE a green row (+0 pass, breaks the gate arithmetic). Therefore the contracts are keyed as override-only entries (match no ledger token/feature) and deepen the SAME dialogs from dialog-visible to dialog-action (button closes dialog), reusing the proven openers from the green rows.

dialogdepth.plugins-close.note: depth: #plugins-dialog opened via Plugins > Manage plugins (opener proven by plugins-dialog token row) is closed by #btn-plugins-close

dialogdepth.ocr-cancel.note: depth: #ocr-dialog (opener proven by ocrrun token row) is closed by #btn-ocr-cancel

dialogdepth.ai-propose-cancel.note: depth: #ai-propose-dialog (opener proven by btn-ai-assistant token row) is closed by #btn-ai-propose-cancel

dialogdepth.speech-close.note: depth: #speech-dialog (opener proven by btn-speech token row) is closed by its Cancel button #btn-speech-close

dialogdepth.speechinput-cancel.note: PROMOTED 2026-11-06 after PRODUCT FIX: the ROUND2 wiring loop (editor.js) only wired btn-<name>-ok/-close, never -cancel — #btn-speechinput-cancel was a dead button; the loop now wires cancel to closeOverlayDialog

dialogdepth.settings-cancel.note: depth: #settings-dialog (opener proven by aisettings token row) is closed by #btn-settings-cancel

dialogdepth.settings-ok.note: depth: #settings-dialog (opener proven by aisettings token row) is closed by its Apply button #btn-settings-ok

dialogdepth.mailmerge-close.note: depth: #mailmerge-dialog (opener proven by mailmerge token row) is closed by #btn-mailmerge-close

dialogdepth.protect-cancel.note: depth: #protect-dialog (opener proven by base protect.encrypt row) is closed by #btn-protect-cancel

dialogdepth.speechinput-ok.note: depth: #speechinput-dialog (opener proven by dictate token row) is closed by its OK button #btn-speechinput-ok
